summary: Skill lifecycle foundation (cinatra#1361): typed lifecycle_state (nullable + CHECK), superseded_by (self-FK), and active_revision_id (composite FK) columns on the existing skills table; immutable append-only skill_revisions history (distinct event id, source enum, base-digest provenance) with a BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger; skill_lifecycle_audit transition log. Backfills existing custom/personal skills to active and seeds a migration revision + active-revision pointer. Destructive because it adds CHECK/FK constraints over the populated skills table.
